data.title: Panoramic tour of Matera in Ape Calessino
data.description: Visit the city of Matera with a typical Italian transport, the Ape Calessino.
data.about:
Lead into the streets of Matera with this special tour.
With the Ape Calessino tour, you'll have the chance to admire the wonderful atmosphere of Matera, the European Capital of Culture 2019. Comfort, style and culture are all combined in one of the most unique tours of the city. Quality and professionalism are guaranteed to give you the best possible service.In 45 minutes you'll visit the most iconic sites of the city: Chiesa del Purgatorio, Cattedrale di Matera, Chiesa di San Giovanni, Sasso Barisano (Veduta Panoramica), Sasso Caveoso (Veduta Panoramica di San Pietro Caveoso) and Piazza Vittorio Veneto.

data.title: Bari Walking Tour (min. 4 adults)
data.description: Buy your Bari City Walk with Musement and explore Bari discovering picturesque and hidden corners with an expert guide.
data.about: Tour begins visiting the main attractions of the old town such as the Basilica of Saint Nicholas with its precious Crypt, the ancient Cathedral of Saint Sabinus and the millenary Swabian Castle.Tour goes on walking along the authentic narrow streets, where old ladies still make pasta by hand, kids play outdoor and people cook in every corner. Tour ends discovering the modern French part of the city with opera theaters, luxury shopping streets, the famous fish market on the sea-side and the lively squares where a taste of local products is not to be missed. Seal the deal tasting delicious italian home made ice cream.

data.title: Bari History & Culture Walking Tour (min. 2 adults)
data.description: Buy your Bari and its history tour with Musement and explore traces of the past past of monuments, churches and nobile buildings.
data.about: Tour begins visiting the main attractions of the old town such as the Basilica of Saint Nicholas with its precious Crypt. Tour goes on visiting two museums of your choice: Succorpo of the Cathedral, to discover underground Roman walls and crypt; Archaeological museum of Santa Scolastica, to find out the traces of Peuceti, the first inhabitants of the city; Swebian Castle, to see the collection of plaster casts and temporary art exhibitions; Palazzo Simi, a palace built on a Byzantine church, to admire ancient pottery; Civic Museum, to evoke the atmosphere of the city from the Renaissance period to the present days. Tour ends discovering the modern French part of the city along the famous sea-side, opera theatres and luxury shopping streets and the lively squares where a taste of local products is not to be missed.

data.title: The secrets of Barocco walking tour of Lecce
data.description: Discover the highlights of Leccese Baroque architecture on a guided walking tour including Duomo Square and St. Oronzo Square.
data.about: Join a fascinating tour through the history of Lecce from the old Messapian and Roman times to the splendor of the city during the Renaissance and the Baroque Period. A professional guide will tell you about the history and the enchanting architecture of the buildings.Discover more about Baroque architecture by taking a walk in the beautiful city of Lecce, known as the Capital of Apulia. Start in Duomo Square with the Cathedral, the Bell Tower, the Bishop Palace and the Seminary. Continue to St. Irene Church along the main street Vittorio Emanuele II to reach Lecce's main square, St. Oronzo Square, where the Roman Amphitheatre is located. End up with the Church of the Holy Cross and the Celestini Palace, the symbols of Leccese Baroque style.

data.title: Winery tour and tasting in Salento at the Leone de Castris winery
data.description: Visit Salento and don't miss out on the Leone de Castris winery with its famous Salice Salentino and Five Roses wine. Wine tasting with optional snacks or lunch.
data.about:
The winery was founded in 1665 by a Spanish man: the count of Lemos. In 1925 the first wine was bottled by Piero and Lisetta Leone de Castris, the grandparents of the current owner Piernicola Leone de Castris. In 1943 the Five Roses was born - the first rosé ever to be bottled in Italy. Furthermore, this was followed by the 50° Vendemmia Salice Salentino Riserve - the first Salice red wine to be bottled in 1954, still 20 years before the birth of the DOC Salice Salentino.
The Experience
- Presentation of the winery with historical background included
- Visit to the wine cellar where wines are aged
- Explanation of the production chain from harvesting to bottling 
- Guided tour of the “Piero e Salvatore Leone de Castris” Wine Museum
- The possibility to purchase wines at “Il Bottegone Leone de Castris” shop

Offer
Three options with differing prices:
- "LA GRANDE TRADIZIONE" TOUR: Guided tour of the historical offices, cellar and Museum 'Piero e Salvatore Leone de Castris' and technical tasting of three wines identifying the company: Messapia Verdeca Igt Salento, Five Roses Anniversary Rosato Igt Salento, 50th Harvest Salice Salentino DOC Riserva: € 24.00 (2 - 80 people max)
- "FOOD EXPERIENCE" TOUR: Guided tour of the historical offices, cellar and Museum 'Piero e Salvatore Leone de Castris' with light lunch buffet and tasting of three wines identifying the company: Messapia Verdeca Igt Salento, Five Roses Anniversary RosatoIgt Salento, 50th Harvest Salice Salentino DOC Riserva: € 44.00 (2 - 80 people max)
- "DONNA LISA" TOUR (from April to September): Guided tour of the historical offices, cellar and Museum 'Piero e Salvatore Leone de Castris', with lunch and tasting of 3 wines in combination with the chef's dishes, at the Milo Restaurant of the Hotel Villa Donna Lisa, next to the cellar: € 52,00 (8 - 80 people max)
 Please note: there is a discount for groups of more than 10 people - for more information, please send a request from the Musement Food&Wine page under the "Tailor Made Tours" tab.
